extraction.title: Implement recovery key support for user storage providers
extraction.head: feature-recovery-keys-implementation

greptile.text: Summarizes the PR as adding recovery code support for user storage providers via a federated-then-local credential lookup, a CredentialHelper creation abstraction, expanded backwards-compatibility test infrastructure, and updated authenticators and required actions. Confidence score 3/5, citing unsafe Optional handling in RecoveryAuthnCodeInputLoginBean.java and limited error handling in BackwardsCompatibilityUserStorage.java.
Calling get() on the Optional credential without checking presence will throw NoSuchElementException when no recovery credential exists. Suggests orElseThrow with a clear message.
Two chained get() calls (getNextRecoveryAuthnCode() and the outer Optional get) lack null checks and can throw. Suggests orElseThrow for the next recovery code.
Minor typo in the Javadoc: 'a optional' should be 'an optional' ("a optional").
Recovery codes are deserialized as raw List.class, but should be typed as List<String> to match the expected data structure.
Claims the log.error message for recovery-codes deserialization failure has a double space between 'deserialize' and 'credential'. The suggested replacement looks identical to the original.
Raw List type in the readValue call should be List<String> so recovery code validation is type-safe.
Typo in config alias: 'delayed-suthenticator-config' should be 'delayed-authenticator-config'.
